meta.source: X1 multi-scale TTA + recommended production defaults
meta.notes: Per-class conf empirically derived from V2.0 X1 eval. Production should A/B test these on-site with real data and adjust. Glass/mold use LOW conf for safety (miss-is-worse-than-false-alarm scenarios).

insect.rationale: Strong signal, balanced F1. ULTRA val mAP50=0.891 TTA.

color_anomaly.rationale: Weak, moderate conf. val mAP50=0.649. Tune down if FP rate too high.

bone.rationale: Medium signal. val mAP50=0.705. Lower to 0.10 if missing small bones.

glass.rationale: SAFETY-CRITICAL: prefer false alarms over missed glass. val mAP50=0.754.

hair.rationale: Strong signal with some false positives. val mAP50=0.782.

mold.rationale: HARDEST class - low conf to maximize recall. val mAP50=0.467 (only 39 val imgs - high variance). Production should collect more mold data.
